result.title: SearchChord: Prompt Preselection and Field Recomposition for One-Step Image Editing
result.summary: Finding effective prompts and seeds for one-step image editors requires balancing edit fidelity, source preservation, and computational cost. To address this challenge, we explore a large collection of candidate edits, where each candidate is defined by a unique prompt-seed pair, and generate corresponding images on demand. We present SearchChord, a training-free framework that leverages a large pool of such candidates, combining text-based preselection, image verification, and latent-field recomposition. Our ablation studies across pool sizes up to 200 candidates show that a pool of 100 offers a cost-effective operating point. Compared with feeding all 100 candidates into recomposition, TextSim preselects a subset of 10 candidates. Rather than uniform averaging, we incorporate image-verifier scores to weight each candidate during recomposition. Experiments on PIE-Bench and the proposed CropWeed-EditBench reveal a trade-off: candidate selection improves target-text alignment, while recomposition better preserves unmodified source content. The oracle verifier achieves the best performance in both preservation and target-text alignment. Practical verification partially recovers semantic alignment, but recomposition still compromises edit fidelity, including in agricultural image edits. These results motivate text-first preselection and stronger verification to balance preservation, fidelity, and cost. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SearchChord，一个免训练的一步图像编辑框架：先按文本相似度从 prompt-seed 候选池中预选少量候选，再用图像验证器打分对 latent field 做加权重组，取代均匀平均，并在成本、保留度与编辑保真度之间权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选搜索—图像验证—按验证得分加权重组 latent 场」可能为多 latent 假设的聚合与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索；但该工作属图像编辑，不涉及推理状态生成，迁移需谨慎。
